scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,server,mcp -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:mcp"
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:server && pnpm build:mcp && pnpm build:web
scripts.start:chat-server: cd chat-server && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5298 --reload
scripts.start:chat-server:prod: cd chat-server && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5298
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n web,server,mcp,chat -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:mcp" "pnpm start:chat-server"
scripts.stop:all: bash -lc 'for p in 5199 5198 5197 5298; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$p); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; done'
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
